svg.style: background-color: #07030d; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;

g.text: 1. Radiometric Terrain Correction (RTC): Calibrate DN² to γ⁰ dB.
2. Deep Learning Segmentation: PyTorch U-Net inference across tiles.
3. Dual-Polarization Ratio Filter: VV/VH ratio rejects look-alikes.
4. Radiometric Floor Gate: Δσ⁰ < 2.5 dB confirms clean calm water.
5. Morphometry (PCA): Length, width, area, centroid in LocalAEQD.
6. Kinematic Age Proxy: Advection elapsed hours (T_origin → T_sat).
IoU (Oil): 0.8891 · Pixel Accuracy: 98.44% · False Positive Rate: 1.06%
2. Wind Leeway (α = 3.1%): Coriolis deflection angle θ = ±12°.
4. Monte-Carlo Ensemble: 50 seeded particles rewound 12h backwards.
5. Spill Origin Zone: Converged centroid + uncertainty radius R_zone.
6. Forward 24h Dispersion: 90th percentile swept cone + landfall check.
Numerical Reversibility Error: < 1 mm · Ensemble Size: 50 Particles
1. Spatiotemporal Funnel: Query indexed BBox (±1.5°) & Window (±3h).
4. 5-Pillar Score: Proximity, Time, Course Alignment, Prior, Behavior.
6. Ranked Output: Solid-to-hairline evidence bar & legal dossier.
Attribution Latency: < 35 ms · Scheme: ITU-R M.1371 / MARPOL Annex I
• U_curr: CMEMS surface velocity grid (hourly, bicubic)
• U_wind10: ERA5 10m atmospheric wind vector field
• α = 0.031: Empirical 3.1% wind leeway transfer factor
• R(θ): Coriolis leeway rotation matrix (θ = +12° N / -12° S)
• RK2 Midpoint: X_n+1 = X_n + Δt · V(X_n + Δt/2 · k1, tn + Δt/2)
Score = 100 × [ ( Σ w_i · S_i ) / Σ w_i ] × C_track
• S_prox (30%): exp(-d_min / R_zone) — Closest approach to origin
• S_traj (10%): max(0, cos(COG - θ_advection)) — Course match
